title: Brief Loss Of Control & Imperial Supply
gameText: USED: Lose 1 Force to activate 2 Force. LOST: Just after the weapons phase of a battle, use 2 Force to cause each player to target one of that player's characters involved in the battle. Target characters cannot apply their ability toward drawing battle destiny this turn. OR Lose 1 Force to activate 4 Force.

title: Dark Collaboration & Charming To The Last
gameText: If Tarkin and either Tagge or Motti are in a battle together, you may add two battle destiny. (If Tarkin is also with Leia, add two additional battle destiny.)

title: I Have You Now & Your Powers Are Weak, Old Man
gameText: If a Dark Jedi and a Rebel with ability > 2 are involved in the same battle, you may add one battle destiny (add two destiny if Rebel is Luke, three destiny if Rebel is Obi-Wan).

title: Blast Door Controls & Reactor Terminal
gameText: Deploy on table. Cancels: Into The Garbage Chute, Flyboy, Narrow Escape, Blast The Door Kid!, and Rebel Barrier. Also, during your control phase, you may return any cards from your hand to the top of your Used Pile.
